cohort: 64 pregnant women admitted with COVID-19 disease at a tertiary pandemic center in CMOSHMC, Bangladesh, between March 15 and October 15, 2021.
finding: Among 64 pregnant women with COVID-19, 31% required ICU admission, 11% died, and preterm birth occurred in 35% of deliveries.
mod_finding: Of the 23 deliveries, 48% were vaginal and 52% were cesarean; cesarean section indications included severe/critical COVID-19 status (n=3) and obstetric causes (n=9).
gest_age: 29 to 39 weeks (95% in the 3rd trimester), 2 previable
followup_time: Varied, with some patients discharged after recovery (D16-D21) and neonatal deaths occurring on D13 and D17.
birth_weight: Not mentioned, but IUGR was observed in some neonates
